entries.title: Psalms 89:1
segments: <<Maschil of Ethan the Ezrahite.>> I will sing of the lovingkindness of Jehovah for ever: With my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness to all generations.

entries.title: Psalms 89:2
segments: For I have said, Mercy shall be built up for ever; Thy faithfulness wilt thou establish in the very heavens.

entries.title: Psalms 89:3
segments: I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn unto David my servant:

entries.title: Psalms 89:4
segments: Thy seed will I establish for ever, And build up thy throne to all generations. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 89:5
segments: And the heavens shall praise thy wonders, O Jehovah; Thy faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.

entries.title: Psalms 89:6
segments: For who in the skies can be compared unto Jehovah? Who among the  sons of the  mighty is like unto Jehovah,

entries.title: Psalms 89:7
segments: A God very terrible in the council of the holy ones, And to be feared above all them that are round about him?

entries.title: Psalms 89:8
segments: O Jehovah God of hosts, Who is a mighty one, like unto thee, O  Jehovah? And thy faithfulness is round about thee.

entries.title: Psalms 89:9
segments: Thou rulest the pride of the sea: When the waves thereof arise, thou stillest them.

entries.title: Psalms 89:10
segments: Thou hast broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; Thou hast scattered thine enemies with the arm of thy strength.

entries.title: Psalms 89:11
segments: The heavens are thine, the earth also is thine: The world and the fulness thereof, thou hast founded them.

entries.title: Psalms 89:12
segments: The north and the south, thou hast created them: Tabor and Hermon rejoice in thy name.

entries.title: Psalms 89:13
segments: Thou hast  a mighty arm; Strong is thy hand, and high is thy right hand.

entries.title: Psalms 89:14
segments: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of thy throne: Lovingkindness and truth go before thy face.

entries.title: Psalms 89:15
segments: Blessed is the people that know the  joyful sound: They walk, O Jehovah, in the light of thy countenance.

entries.title: Psalms 89:16
segments: In thy name do they rejoice all the day; And in thy righteousness are they exalted.

entries.title: Psalms 89:17
segments: For thou art the glory of their strength; And in thy favor  our horn shall be exalted.

entries.title: Psalms 89:18
segments: For our shield belongeth unto Jehovah;  And our king to the Holy One of Israel.

entries.title: Psalms 89:19
segments: Then thou spakest in vision to thy  saints, And saidst, I have laid help upon one that is mighty; I have exalted one chosen out of the people.

entries.title: Psalms 89:20
segments: I have found David my servant; With my holy oil have I anointed him:

entries.title: Psalms 89:21
segments: With whom my hand shall be established; Mine arm also shall strengthen him.

entries.title: Psalms 89:22
segments: The enemy shall not  exact from him, Nor the son of wickedness afflict him.

entries.title: Psalms 89:23
segments: And I will beat down his adversaries before him, And smite them that hate him.

entries.title: Psalms 89:24
segments: But my faithfulness and my lovingkindness shall be with him; And in my name shall his horn be exalted.

entries.title: Psalms 89:25
segments: I will set his hand also on the sea, And his right hand on the rivers.

entries.title: Psalms 89:26
segments: He shall cry unto me, Thou art my Father, My God, and the rock of my salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 89:27
segments: I also will make him [my] first-born, The highest of the kings of the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 89:28
segments: My lovingkindness will I keep for him for evermore; And my covenant shall  stand fast with him.

entries.title: Psalms 89:29
segments: His seed also will I make to endure for ever, And his throne as the days of heaven.

entries.title: Psalms 89:30
segments: If his children forsake my law, And walk not in mine ordinances;

entries.title: Psalms 89:31
segments: If they  break my statutes, And keep not my commandments;

entries.title: Psalms 89:32
segments: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, And their iniquity with stripes.

entries.title: Psalms 89:33
segments: But my lovingkindness will I not utterly take from him, Nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.

entries.title: Psalms 89:34
segments: My covenant will I not break, Nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips.

entries.title: Psalms 89:35
segments: Once have I sworn by my holiness: I will not lie unto David:

entries.title: Psalms 89:36
segments: His seed shall endure for ever, And his throne as the sun before me.

entries.title: Psalms 89:37
segments: It shall be established for ever as the moon,  And [as] the faithful witness in the sky. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 89:38
segments: But thou hast cast off and rejected, Thou hast been wroth with thine anointed.

entries.title: Psalms 89:39
segments: Thou hast abhorred the covenant of thy servant: Thou hast profaned his crown [by casting it] to the ground.

entries.title: Psalms 89:40
segments: Thou hast broken down all his hedges; Thou hast brought his strongholds to ruin.

entries.title: Psalms 89:41
segments: All that pass by the way rob him: He is become a reproach to his neighbors.

entries.title: Psalms 89:42
segments: Thou hast exalted the right hand of his adversaries; Thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.

entries.title: Psalms 89:43
segments: Yea, thou turnest back the edge of his sword, And hast not made him to stand in the battle.

entries.title: Psalms 89:44
segments: Thou hast made his brightness to cease, And cast his throne down to the ground.

entries.title: Psalms 89:45
segments: The days of his youth hast thou shortened: Thou hast covered him with shame. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 89:46
segments: How long, O Jehovah? wilt thou hide thyself for ever? [How long] shall thy wrath burn like fire?

entries.title: Psalms 89:47
segments: Oh remember how short my time is: For what vanity hast thou created all the children of men!

entries.title: Psalms 89:48
segments: What man is he that shall live and not see death, That shall deliver his soul from the  power of Sheol? Selah

entries.title: Psalms 89:49
segments: Lord, where are thy former lovingkindnesses, Which thou swarest unto David in thy faithfulness?

entries.title: Psalms 89:50
segments: Remember, Lord, the reproach of thy servants; How I do bear in my bosom [the reproach of] all the  mighty peoples,

entries.title: Psalms 89:51
segments: Wherewith thine enemies have reproached, O Jehovah, Wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.

entries.title: Psalms 89:52
segments: Blessed be Jehovah for evermore. Amen, and Amen.
